text: This week, user CDE1846 (Carlos Dieter Ewing) triggered rule R3 due to an unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients. Specifically, they sent 57.08 MB of email attachments, which is significantly above their typical range of 9.49 MB and above the peer range of 6.96 MB. Additionally, they sent attachments to 33 external recipients, which is also above their typical range of 15 and the peer range of 13.
